The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sulan (Nautolan)|Sulan]] had a '''Padawan''' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Sulan's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during one of Sulan's [[Force-bond/Legends|Force-bonding]] exercises with [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dogs]], creatures that were rumored to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], when a particularly hungry akk dog pack leader attacked the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and killed Sulan's Padawan.<ref name="Akk Dog" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sulan's Padawan was mentioned in the Codex entry for akk dogs in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Akk Dog" />
